title: Money Farm Pte. Ltd buys S$41,000 of Moneymax Financial Services Ltd shares
body: Money Farm Pte. Ltd bought 100,000 shares of Moneymax Financial Services Ltd in a market transaction at S$0.41 per share, for a total of S$41,000. Total interest rises from 738,415,021 shares (57.96%) to 738,515,021 shares (57.97%).
remarks_text: The shareholding percentage before and after the change in interest are computed based on the total number of issued shares of 1,273,909,411 shares (excluding treasury shares).

title: Lim Liang Eng's deemed interest in Moneymax Financial Services Ltd rises after S$41,000 share purchase
body: Lim Liang Eng's deemed interest in Moneymax Financial Services Ltd rose after Money Farm Pte. Ltd bought 100,000 shares at S$0.41 per share, for a total of S$41,000. The direct holding is unchanged at 14,822,221 shares. Total interest rises from 753,237,242 shares (59.12%) to 753,337,242 shares (59.13%).
deemed_interest_text: Mdm. Lim Liang Eng and her associates are entitled to exercise all the votes attached to the voting shares in Money Farm Pte. Ltd. As such, pursuant to Section 4 of the Securities and Futures Act, Mdm. Lim Liang Eng is deemed interested in the shares which Money Farm Pte. Ltd. holds in MoneyMax Financial Services Ltd.
remarks_text: The shareholding percentage before and after the change in interest are computed based on the total number of issued shares of 1,273,909,411 shares (excluding treasury shares).
change_reason: the acquisition of 100,000 ordinary shares by Money Farm Pte. Ltd

title: Lim Yong Guan's deemed interest in Moneymax Financial Services Ltd rises after S$41,000 share purchase

The direct holding is unchanged at 151,186,666 shares. Total interest rises from 900,391,813 shares (70.68%) to 900,491,813 shares (70.69%).

title: CLI Asset Management Pte. Ltd's deemed interest in CapitaLand India Trust rises after payment of management fees in 2.3M units
body: CLI Asset Management Pte. Ltd's deemed interest in CapitaLand India Trust rose after Clintmpl received 2,288,153 units as payment of management fees, valued at S$0.9191 per unit, or S$2,103,041 in total. No units are held directly. Total interest rises from 119,006,501 units (7.99%) to 121,294,654 units (8.13%).
deemed_interest_text: CLINTMPL is a wholly owned subsidiary of CLIAM. CLIAM is deemed to be interested in 121,294,654 units held by CLINTMPL.
remarks_text: In relation to item 9 of Part II: 1.  The percentage of total number of ordinary voting units held "Immediately before the transaction" is computed based on 1,488,952,815 issued units as of 12 August 2026. 2. The percentage of total number of ordinary voting units held "Immediately after the transaction" is computed based on 1,491,240,968 issued units as of 6 November 2026. 3. The figures are rounded down to the nearest 0.01%
change_reason: the issuance of units as payment of 50% of the base fee

title: Amova Asset Management Co., Ltd's deemed interest in UI Boustead REIT rises after S$3.9M unit purchase
body: Amova Asset Management Co., Ltd's deemed interest in UI Boustead REIT rose after a party linked to the holder bought 5,062,600 units in a market transaction at S$0.765 per unit, for a total of S$3,872,889. No units are held directly. Total interest rises from 93,052,400 units (6.80%) to 98,115,000 units (7.17%).
deemed_interest_text: Deemed interest in the Listed Issuer are aggregate number of voting units held by portfolios of Amova Co. and its subsidiaries as fund managers.
relationship_text: Sumitomo Mitsui Trust Group, Inc. ("SMTG") has a controlling interest in Amova Co..
